synth.notes:
Player 5x5 moves 6; blocked by y<8, screen edge, wall px in dest box unless it holds the plate centre; first input of a fresh level (n==0) is a no-op logged as a 'stay' path entry.
Plate covered by player/ghost -> wall px left of the line column shift +6 toward it; layer-1 bodies crop the wall; names re-indexed type_%03d in list order (huds, player, gate, target, counter, red hud, ghost, wall).
A5 after moving: respawn at first reached cell; no red hud -> record life path as ghost (red hud at (1,1), huds +4), else clear ghost; A5 unmoved = no-op.
Ghost = recorded path[k] after k successful moves (absent at k=0, hidden/not extracted when on the player) -> explains step 43 (ghost at (20,8) under player, wall stays wall_007).
Counter -1 px on odd calls (hidden parity, stateless n=2*(64-w)-1); stateless respawn default (14,8); alt fit 'lag-1 with start-only-in-life-1' not distinguishable; stateless 19/44.
